info.title: Habitat API
info.summary: OpenAPI spec generated from Habitat's AT Protocol lexicons.
info.description: Welcome to the Habitat API reference! We are currently under development and our API may make breaking changes without notice. Stay tuned [@habitat.network](https://bsky.app/profile/habitat.network) on Bluesky and [habitat.leaflet.pub](https://habitat.leaflet.pub) for future formal releases.

get.description: Get this instance's admin-configurable settings. Requires an authenticated instance admin session.

post.description: Issue a single-use invite token for creating an org on this instance. Requires an authenticated instance admin session.

post.description: Update this instance's admin-configurable settings. Requires an authenticated instance admin session.

post.description: Create a new collaborative document. Implemented by the docs server, which writes the canonical record into the org's docs space using the org credential.

docId.description: The record key identifying the document, used in subsequent updateDoc calls.

get.description: List all documents in the org, with titles. Implemented by the docs server, which lists the doc spaces from pear using the org credential and reads each space's markdown 'self' record for the title.

uri.description: URI of the updated document record.

post.description: Create a new opensocial-backed org mapped to an email domain. The org starts with no members: the first user to sign in with a Google-verified email at the domain becomes its admin, and later ones become members. Does not require authentication.

name.description: Also becomes the connection's ID and the model ID clients request. Letters, digits, dots, hyphens, and underscores only, and must be unique within the org.

post.description: Add an MCP server to the org. Nobody signs in to it yet: for an oauth server pear discovers its authorization server and registers itself as a client, by dynamic client registration unless clientId is given, and each member then connects with startAuthorization; a manual server needs no auth, so every member is connected to it automatically. Either give preset, or give url and authType (and optionally clientId and clientSecret). Requires service-auth. Requires the mcp.configure action.

org.description: DID of the community to add the server to.

name.description: Also becomes the server's ID and the namespace under which its tools are exposed. Letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores only, and must be unique within the org.

preset.description: A known connector to add. pear fills in its URL and auth type and, for an oauth connector, uses the OAuth client it holds for it, shared by all orgs, so url, authType, clientId and clientSecret must be omitted. Fails if an oauth connector has no client configured on this pear.

url.description: The server's streamable HTTP endpoint. Required unless preset is given, in which case it must be omitted.

authType.description: How pear authenticates to the server; see network.habitat.mcp.defs#server. Required unless preset is given, in which case it must be omitted.

clientId.description: oauth servers only: the ID of an OAuth client pre-registered with the server's authorization server, for servers that don't support dynamic client registration. Its redirect URI must be pear's MCP OAuth callback.

clientSecret.description: oauth servers only: the pre-registered client's secret, if it has one. Stored encrypted and never returned.

post.description: Debugging aid: make one raw MCP request to an org-configured server as the caller, and return the server's result or the error exactly as pear saw it. Unlike the gateway's normal paths, a failure is reported in the output (with a 200) rather than as an XRPC error, so callers can show what the server actually said. Requires service-auth. Callable by any org member, who can only reach servers they are connected to.

org.description: DID of the community the server belongs to.

id.description: The server's id, as in network.habitat.mcp.defs#server.

name.description: The tool to call, for tools/call.

arguments.description: The tool's arguments as JSON text (an object), for tools/call. Text rather than a nested object so the exact JSON the caller typed reaches the server, floats included, which the atproto data model can't carry.

uri.description: The resource to read, for resources/read.

ok.description: Whether the server answered the request without an error.

result.description: The server's result as pretty-printed JSON text, when ok. Text rather than a nested object for the same reason as the input's arguments.

error.description: The raw error, when not ok: a JSON-RPC error from the server, an HTTP failure, or why pear couldn't connect.

errorKind.description: Where the failure happened. not_connected: the caller has no usable connection. protocol: the server answered with a JSON-RPC error. transport: connecting or the HTTP exchange failed. invalid_response: the server's reply didn't validate against the MCP schema (for example invalid structuredContent).

org.description: DID of the community the server belongs to.

schema.description: DID of the community to list MCP servers for.

post.description: Remove an org's configured MCP server. Members' stored credentials for it are never used again, even if a server is later added under the same name. Requires service-auth. Requires the mcp.configure action.

org.description: DID of the community the server belongs to.

post.description: Search everywhere the caller's org keeps data at once: Habitat records the caller may read, and every search tool pear knows of the caller's connected MCP servers. Each source is a backend, searched in the background as the caller. The call waits up to timeoutMs and returns what is ready, ranked across every backend; backends still running keep going. Pass cursor to page through the mixed results, or a backend's own cursor to page through only that backend's results, waiting for it if it is still running. A backend that fails, times out, or that the caller isn't connected to is reported in backends without failing the search. Requires service-auth. Callable by any org member.

org.description: DID of the community to search.

query.description: What to search for, typically a few keywords. Required unless cursor is given.

cursor.description: A cursor from a previous response: its top-level cursor continues the mixed results, and a backend's cursor continues only that backend's. The query is then ignored.
Continues this page's results: the mixed results, or the backend's when the request's cursor was a backend's. Omitted when there are no more, now or later.

ranking.description: reranker: a reranking model scored every result against the query. fallback: there is no reranker, or it failed for some results, which are ranked by their place in their backend's own results instead.

post.description: Begin connecting the caller to an org-configured MCP server. For an oauth server, returns the server's authorization URL, for the caller's browser to open; once they approve, the authorization server redirects back to pear, which stores the caller's tokens. For a token server, the caller's access token (for example a personal access token) is required in token; pear stores it, which connects the caller right away, and returns no URL. Requires service-auth. Callable by any org member.

org.description: DID of the community the server belongs to.

token.description: token servers only: the caller's own access token for the server, sent to it as a bearer token. Stored encrypted and never returned.

authorizationUrl.description: oauth servers only: where to send the caller's browser to authorize pear with the server. It's valid for 10 minutes and can be used once. Omitted for a token server, which is connected as soon as the call returns.

post.description: Update an org's configured MCP server. Its name can't be changed, since it's also the server's ID and tool namespace; remove and re-add it under a new name instead. url applies only to manual servers. Requires service-auth. Requires the mcp.configure action.

org.description: DID of the community the server belongs to.

url.description: Manual servers only: the server's new URL.

post.description: Set a member's full role set, replacing whatever roles they previously held. Requires service-auth. get.description: Download an account's permissioned repo within a space as a STAR file, for full-state recovery. The archive's metadata is the repo's commit; each key/value pair is a record path ('{collection}/{rkey}') and the record's DRISL encoding, in strict lexicographic order of the path. Blobs are not included and are fetched separately via getBlob. Served by a repo host. Callable with either OAuth (for the authenticated user's own data) or a space credential (for syncing services). When called with a space credential, the caller must request a MAC with an Accept-Signature header (tag atproto-space-commit), and the response carries the archive commit's MAC in Signature-Input and Signature headers covering an Atproto-Space-Commit header.

get.description: Page through the event log up to a pinned tip as plain HTTP, for catching up on a large backlog before following network.habitat.space.subscribe live. It is the counterpart of Jetstream's planSnapshot replay archive: afterSeq/beforeSeq bound the range, and plannedThroughSeq/tipSeq drive pagination the same way. Jetstream's archive is sealed segment files, so its plan lists files to download; this host's log is one compacted table, so the events themselves are returned inline, as the same #commit and #spaceDeleted objects subscribe frames carry. Read the first page without beforeSeq, then pass the tipSeq it returns as beforeSeq on every later page so the snapshot does not move while it is being read. When plannedThroughSeq reaches tipSeq the snapshot is complete: open subscribe with cursor tipSeq + 1 to follow live without a gap. Events are authorized exactly as on subscribe, and the log is compacted the same way, so a snapshot converges on current state but skips intermediate versions. Callable with OAuth, service auth or a space credential.

parameters.description: Start after this seq: events at or below it are not included. Omitted or 0: from the start of the log.

parameters.name: beforeSeq
parameters.description: Stop at this seq: events above it are not included. Omitted: the log's current head, returned as tipSeq.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of events to return in one page.

get.description: List the spaces the authenticated user holds a repo in (i.e. spaces the user has written data to), optionally filtered by type and/or owner DID. Note this is not 'spaces I'm a member of' — a member's PDS only tracks spaces its user has written to. Requires auth, implemented by PDS.

parameters.name: spaceType
parameters.description: Filter to spaces of this type. Required if the caller's OAuth scope is narrower than `space:*`.

schema.description: Filter to spaces of this type. Required if the caller's OAuth scope is narrower than `space:*`.

parameters.name: did
parameters.description: Filter to spaces owned by this DID. Required if the caller's OAuth scope is narrower than `?did=*`.

schema.description: Filter to spaces owned by this DID. Required if the caller's OAuth scope is narrower than `?did=*`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of spaces to return.

post.description: Notify a repo host that outstanding space credentials were revoked. Sent by the space authority. The repo host MUST reject a credential whose jti has been revoked for that space, and retain the revocation for at least 60 minutes (the maximum credential lifetime). Idempotent, so the authority may safely retry delivery. Authenticated with service auth from the space authority.

space.description: Reference to the space the credentials were issued for.

post.description: Notify a repo host or syncing service that a space has been deleted. Sent by the space authority, best-effort. Authenticated with service auth.
Notify that a repo in a space has advanced to a new revision. Sent by a repo host to the space host, and forwarded to registered syncers. Best-effort. Authenticated with service auth.

repo.description: The DID of the account whose repo advanced.

rev.description: The repo revision after the write.

repoRev.description: The repo revision after the write.

data.description: The repo's current commit data (sha256 of the LtHash state) after the write. Lets the space host maintain each repo's commit data for listRepos.

spaceRev.description: The space revision assigned by the space host. Present only on notifications forwarded to syncers.

prevSpaceRev.description: The previous space revision. Omitted on the first update in a space. A gap indicates missed notifications; recover using listRepos with cursor.

post.description: Write a record in a permissioned space, creating or updating it as needed. Requires auth, implemented by PDS.

repo.description: The DID of the repo to write to (the authenticated member).

collection.description: The NSID of the record collection.

validate.description: Can be set to 'false' to skip Lexicon schema validation of record data, 'true' to require it, or leave unset to validate only for known Lexicons.

post.description: Register a service to be notified of writes. On a space host, subscribes to all repos in the space; on a repo host with a `repo`, subscribes to that repo only. Authenticated with a space credential. Prefer `service`: the registering service is named by its service identifier rather than a bare URL, because notifyWrite is delivered with service auth addressed to that identifier and the delivery endpoint is resolved from the service's DID document. `endpoint` is deprecated and kept only for callers that predate `service`.

repo.description: The DID of a specific repo to subscribe to (repo host). Omit to subscribe to the whole space (space host).

service.description: Service identifier of the subscriber: a DID with an optional service fragment naming the entry in its DID document to deliver to (e.g. 'did:web:syncer.example.com#habitat_space_syncer'). notifyWrite calls are addressed to this identifier, and the delivery endpoint is resolved from the service's DID document. Takes precedence over the deprecated `endpoint` when both are given; one of the two is required.

endpoint.description: Deprecated: the endpoint to which notifyWrite events should be delivered. Superseded by `service`, which resolves the delivery endpoint from the service's DID document and addresses notifications to the service identifier instead of this URL.

get.description: Full-text search over the records in the permissioned spaces the caller can read, most relevant first. Searches one org at a time: the spaces the org owns that the caller can read. Callable with OAuth, service auth, or a space credential; a space credential can only search its own space.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The text to search for. Free-form; not a query syntax.

schema.description: The text to search for. Free-form; not a query syntax.

parameters.name: org
parameters.description: Only search the spaces this org owns, and only the collections it surfaces in search: the defaults plus those its admins configured. Required unless space is given, which implies its owner.

schema.description: Only search the spaces this org owns, and only the collections it surfaces in search: the defaults plus those its admins configured. Required unless space is given, which implies its owner.

parameters.name: space
parameters.description: Only search this space. A space credential only searches its own space, so it is implied there.

schema.description: Only search this space. A space credential only searches its own space, so it is implied there.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Only return records in these collections.

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Only return records from this account's repo.

schema.description: Only return records from this account's repo.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to return. A page can hold fewer, even when more follow.

parameters.name: snippetLength
parameters.description: About how many words of context each record's snippet keeps around the matches.

post.description: Withdraw the caller's pending join request. Requires service auth.
Deny a pending join request, deleting it. To approve one, write the requester's membership instead. Requires auth as the group.
Leave a group, deleting the caller's membership, which the group authored. The caller should also delete their confirmation. Requires service auth.

get.description: List pending join requests, which the host stores privately. Approve one by writing the requester's membership record. Deny requests with 'denyJoinRequest'. Requires auth as the group.
Get moderation history for the caller's account and records. Omits reports, notes, tags, and who acted. Works for former members. Requires service auth.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: The caller's DID or one of their record URIs. Omit for all.

schema.description: The caller's DID or one of their record URIs. Omit for all.

get.description: Get a subject's moderation history. Requires auth as the group.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: An account DID or record URI.

schema.description: An account DID or record URI.

parameters.name: cid
parameters.description: If set, only this version of the record.

schema.description: If set, only this version of the record.

get.description: List subjects in the moderation queue. Requires auth as the group.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Omit for all.

schema.description: Omit for all.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Only subjects with any of these tags.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: oldest and newest go by createdAt. updated puts the latest updatedAt first.

schema.description: oldest and newest go by createdAt. updated puts the latest updatedAt first.

post.description: Appeal a label or ejection on the caller's account or one of their records, reopening it in the moderation queue. Works for former members. Requires service auth.

subject.description: The caller's DID or one of their record URIs.

post.description: Report an account or record in a group, opening or reopening it in the moderation queue. The caller must be able to read the subject's space. Requires service auth.

subject.description: An account DID or record URI.

cid.description: If set, a specific version of the record.

rule.description: The group rule the subject breaks.

post.description: Change a subject's status or tags, or add a note. Omitted fields are left as they are. Requires auth as the group.

subject.description: An account DID or record URI.

cid.description: If set, a specific version of the record.

post.description: Request to join a group, optionally redeeming an invite. Admits the caller right away when the join policy is open or with a valid invite, and otherwise queues a request. Returns the caller's existing request or membership if they have one. Requires service auth.

invite.description: An invite in the caller's inbox space.

message.description: Shown to the group with the request.

com.atproto.label.defs.label.description: Metadata tag on an atproto resource (eg, repo or record).

src.description: DID of the actor who created this label.

uri.description: AT URI of the record, repository (account), or other resource that this label applies to.

cid.description: Optionally, CID specifying the specific version of 'uri' resource this label applies to.

val.description: The short string name of the value or type of this label.

neg.description: If true, this is a negation label, overwriting a previous label.

cts.description: Timestamp when this label was created.

exp.description: Timestamp at which this label expires (no longer applies).

com.atproto.label.defs.selfLabels.description: Metadata tags on an atproto record, published by the author within the record.

com.atproto.label.defs.selfLabel.description: Metadata tag on an atproto record, published by the author within the record. Note that schemas should use #selfLabels, not #selfLabel.

val.description: The short string name of the value or type of this label.

com.atproto.label.defs.labelValueDefinit.description: Declares a label value and its expected interpretations and behaviors.

identifier.description: The value of the label being defined. Must only include lowercase ascii and the '-' character ([a-z-]+).

severity.description: How should a client visually convey this label? 'inform' means neutral and informational; 'alert' means negative and warning; 'none' means show nothing.

blurs.description: What should this label hide in the UI, if applied? 'content' hides all of the target; 'media' hides the images/video/audio; 'none' hides nothing.

defaultSetting.description: The default setting for this label.

adultOnly.description: Does the user need to have adult content enabled in order to configure this label?

com.atproto.label.defs.labelValueDefinit.description: Strings which describe the label in the UI, localized into a specific language.

lang.description: The code of the language these strings are written in.

name.description: A short human-readable name for the label.

description.description: A longer description of what the label means and why it might be applied.

slug.description: A DNS-safe name for the app (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens), set when the app is created. Part of the app's run URL, so it doesn't change when the app is renamed.

entrypoint.description: The path of the main module within the bundle: an ES module whose default export has a fetch handler.

compatibilityDate.description: The Workers compatibility date the code runs with (YYYY-MM-DD).

createdBy.description: The member who created the app. The record itself is written by the org.

updatedBy.description: The member who deployed the current version.

title.description: The session's title, taken from the first message.

anchorStart.description: Yjs relative position (Y.encodeRelativePosition, applied to the doc's 'default' XML fragment) marking the start of the commented range. Together with anchorEnd and the document's current CRDT state, this is sufficient to resolve the exact range being commented on — an editor placing this comment needs no other context, and the position survives concurrent edits made anywhere else in the document the way a plain character offset would not.

anchorEnd.description: Yjs relative position marking the end of the commented range. See anchorStart.

quotedText.description: A snapshot of the document text the anchor pointed to when the comment was created, shown as a fallback if the anchor no longer resolves to a valid range (e.g. the text was later deleted entirely).

network.habitat.docs.commentReply.commen.description: A URI with a content-hash fingerprint — the same shape as com.atproto.repo.strongRef, defined locally for now because lexgen doesn't generate Go bindings for com.atproto.* refs.

blob.description: Base64-encoded Yjs state update representing the document content.

docId.description: The doc's space key, used as the document identifier in updateDoc and routing.

title.description: The document title, from its markdown 'self' record.
The document title, derived from the first heading or line.

content.description: The rendered markdown content of the document.

name.description: The file's original name, including its extension.

uploadedBy.description: The member who uploaded the file. The record itself is written by the org.

lastUsed.description: The last time habitat detected a session with this app.

logoUri.description: The logo URI of this app.

network.habitat.llm.defs.connection.description: An LLM model connection configured for an org.

id.description: The connection's identifier, unique within the org. Equal to name.

name.description: The model ID clients request through the org's OpenAI-compatible API.

provider.description: The provider API pear calls the model through. openai: OpenAI or any OpenAI-compatible API, such as OpenRouter, with baseUrl. anthropic: Anthropic's Messages API. google: the Gemini API. ollama: an Ollama server at baseUrl.

model.description: The provider's identifier for the model.

hasApiKey.description: Whether an API key is stored for this connection. The key itself is never returned.

network.habitat.mcp.defs.server.description: An MCP server configured for an org.

id.description: The server's identifier, unique within the org.

authType.description: How pear authenticates to the server. oauth: each member signs in with their own account via MCP OAuth, run by pear, which stores their tokens encrypted. token: each member supplies their own access token (such as a personal access token) with startAuthorization, which pear stores encrypted and sends to the server as a bearer token. manual: the server needs no auth, so an admin configured its URL once for the whole org and every member is connected automatically.

connected.description: Whether the caller can reach this server: always for a manual server, and for an oauth server once the caller has authorized it.

backend.description: Id of the backend the result came from, as in backends.

kind.description: record: a Habitat record, described in record. item: a result from a connected app.

id.description: Identifies the result within its backend.

url.description: Where to open the result: the app's link for an item, the record's URI for a record.

id.description: Stable id, such as records or mcp:github/github-issues.

status.description: pending: still running. ok: answered, possibly with no results. error: failed. timeout: didn't answer within pear's backend timeout. not_connected: the caller has no usable connection to the server; they never connected, or their sign-in expired.

errorCode.description: Why the backend has no results, for any status but pending and ok. interrupted: pear restarted while the backend was running; search again.

error.description: What went wrong, safe to show.

cursor.description: Fetches this backend's results only. Omitted when it has none left to fetch.

network.habitat.opensocial.defs.inviteVi.description: A pending invite to join the community, tracked in the org's invite table (not yet a repo record).

id.description: Opaque id of the invite, used to revoke it.

org.description: DID of the community the invite is for.

role.description: Record key of the role this binding applies to.

displayName.description: The member's display name within the community.

bio.description: A short bio for the member.

avatarUrl.description: URL of the member's avatar image.

network.habitat.relationship.listRelatio.description: A user relation record together with its URI.

subject.description: DID of the user the role is granted to.

object.description: URI of the space the role is granted on.

network.habitat.relationship.listRelatio.description: A space relation record together with its URI.

subject.description: URI of the subject space (or group-space) whose role-holders form the userset.

subjectRole.description: The role held on the subject space, forming the userset.

object.description: URI of the space the role is granted on.

subject.description: URI of the subject space (or group-space) whose role-holders form the userset.

subjectRole.description: The role held on the subject space, forming the userset.

relation.description: Role granted on the object space (owner|manager|writer|reader).

subject.description: DID of the user the role is granted to.

relation.description: Role granted on the object space (owner|manager|writer|reader).

network.habitat.relationspace.policy.description: A space policy: access is decided by the space's network.habitat.relationship userRelation and spaceRelation records (owner, manager, writer, reader), which the authority and its managers maintain. No configuration.

targetLexicon.description: The NSID of the lexicon this render schema applies to.

title.description: Human-readable name for this record type.

description.description: A brief description of what this record type represents.

network.habitat.render.schema.fieldSchem.description: Describes how to display a single field of a record.

path.description: Dot-notation path into the record value (e.g. 'name', 'startsAt').

optional.description: If true, omit this field from display when its value is missing or empty.

network.habitat.render.schema.datetime.description: Render as a formatted date/time string.

network.habitat.render.schema.badge.description: Render as a pill badge, extracting the token name from an NSID#token value.

network.habitat.render.schema.list.description: Render as a list of items.

network.habitat.render.schema.primary.description: Most prominent display — used for the record's main identifier (e.g. title).

network.habitat.render.schema.metadata.description: De-emphasized display, shown at the bottom or collapsed.

spaceUri.description: URI of the space the record belongs to.

recordType.description: The NSID of the record type.

snippet.description: A highlighted excerpt of the matching content.

note.description: Optional human-readable label for this grant, for admin display. Not used for enforcement.

network.habitat.space.applyWrites.create.description: Operation which creates a new record.

network.habitat.space.applyWrites.update.description: Operation which updates an existing record.

network.habitat.space.applyWrites.delete.description: Operation which deletes an existing record.

network.habitat.space.defs.commit.description: A commit over the current state of a permissioned repo. Carries no signature: the repo host authenticates it to a syncer with a MAC over its Atproto-Space-Commit response header.

repo.description: The author DID of the repo.

data.description: sha256 digest of the LtHash state (32 bytes).

network.habitat.space.listRepoOps.opEntr.description: A single operation in a permissioned repo's oplog. cid is null for deletes; prev is null for creates. Operations sharing the same rev belong to the same batch. value carries the record's current value for creates and updates, unless excludeValues was set or the value is stale (superseded by a later operation).

did.description: The DID of a repo that holds data in the space.

rev.description: The repo's current revision (TID), as last reported to the authority. May lag the repo host, which is the source of truth.

repoRev.description: The repo's current revision (TID), as last reported to the authority. May lag the repo host, which is the source of truth.

data.description: The repo's current commit data (sha256 of the LtHash state), as last reported to the authority.

spaceRev.description: The space revision at which this repo was last updated.

snippet.description: A fragment of the record's text with the matches wrapped in <mark></mark>. The rest is unescaped record text, so escape it before rendering as HTML.

network.habitat.space.subscribe.commit.description: A record's latest write: a create, update, or delete.

space.description: The space the record belongs to. The same author, collection, and rkey can exist in several spaces.

did.description: The record's author: the account whose space repo holds it.

time.description: When the write was stored, microsecond precision.

rev.description: The repo revision of the write; the record's oplog rev in listRepoOps.

cid.description: CID of the record. Absent for deletes.

network.habitat.space.subscribe.spaceDel.description: A space was deleted. Consumers drop every record and derived state they hold for it.

time.description: When the space was deleted, microsecond precision.

network.habitat.space.subscribe.info.description: An advisory, non-fatal notice about the stream. Carries no seq and does not advance the cursor. FutureCursor: the requested cursor was beyond the next seq to be assigned, so the stream started at the live tip.

website.description: Group website. Must be http or https.

joinPolicy.description: open admits anyone; approval queues a join request; invite requires an invitation. An invitation admits its recipient under any policy.

org.atgrp.labeler.policies.description: The group's label values and their definitions.

org.atgrp.mod.defs.subjectView.description: A subject in the moderation queue.

subject.description: An account DID or record URI.

cid.description: If set, a specific version of the record.

org.atgrp.mod.defs.eventView.description: An event in a subject's moderation history.

subject.description: An account DID or record URI.

cid.description: If set, a specific version of the record.

createdBy.description: May be withheld to protect reporters and moderators.

org.atgrp.mod.defs.statusEvent.description: A moderator changed the subject's status or added a note.

org.atgrp.mod.defs.tagEvent.description: A moderator added or removed tags.

org.atgrp.mod.defs.labelEvent.description: A label record was written or deleted.

org.atgrp.mod.defs.ejectEvent.description: The subject was ejected from the group.

org.atgrp.policy.description: Space policy for group spaces: each role's access and permissions in the space, whether it is public, and whether it is listed in the space index. The host always publishes it in the space as a com.atproto.space.policy record.

publicRead.description: If true, anyone may read the space.

unlisted.description: If true, the host leaves the space out of the group's space index. Ignored for the meta and members spaces.

org.atgrp.policy.grant.description: A role's grants in one space. read and write apply to members acting as themselves; permissions apply to acting as the group.

read.description: If true, members with this role may read the space.

write.description: If true, members with this role are in the space's writer set, so their own records sync to readers.

default.description: If true, granted to members admitted through requestJoin.
